title: Evidence Kind And Verification Provenance Contract
summary: Expose the kind of evidence and the way it was verified as two closed, consumer-neutral axes without conflating either with lifecycle status or authority.
retrievalAnchor: Evidence kind and verification provenance are orthogonal to lifecycle status and authority.

release.compatibility: The historical v1.25 authority cutover requires an explicit generator-v17 rebuild. Native CF2 additionally requires an explicit generator-v20 rebuild for bounded searchable text and redaction before clipping. No compatibility reader or implicit migration is retained.

axes.evidence_kind: What kind of carrier produced this row.
axes.verification_level: What deterministic observation or trusted receipt supports this row.
axes.status: Lifecycle or currentness declared or inferred by the existing authority model.
axes.authority_level: Repository authority and ranking signal owned by the existing authority model.
axes.orthogonality: History, proposal state, acceptance, source-of-truth, and confidence are not evidence kinds or verification levels.

evidenceKinds.implementation-source: Code, configuration, or structured application/workflow source extracted from current source bytes. The name makes no production-deployment claim.
evidenceKinds.test-source: Test code or a test definition selected by exact path and filename conventions. It does not claim the test executed or passed.
evidenceKinds.machine-contract: Schema, manifest, protocol, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, or typed contract evidence.
evidenceKinds.decision-record: ADR, decision index, or typed decision evidence.
evidenceKinds.operational-document: Runbook, deployment, operations, or security operations documentation.
evidenceKinds.generated-artifact: Reserved for an artifact with trusted explicit lineage. A generated directory name, filename suffix, or arbitrary JSON field cannot grant this kind.
evidenceKinds.structured-evidence: JSON or JSONL facts, findings, and other structured evidence that is not independently trusted lineage.
evidenceKinds.reference-document: Planning, handoff, index, context, history, and neutral fallback documentation; lifecycle and authority remain separate fields.

verificationLevels.declared: The value is asserted by a document, contract, or structured record and parsed without an execution claim.
verificationLevels.source-observed: The row is deterministically extracted from the exact current source bytes selected for the snapshot or source scan.
verificationLevels.validated: Reserved for a trusted validation receipt bound to source content, snapshot, gate identity, and validation contract.
verificationLevels.executed: Reserved for a trusted execution receipt bound to source content, snapshot, gate identity, and execution contract. Pass or failure belongs in a separate outcome field.
verificationLevels.trustRule: Arbitrary source JSON, JSONL, path names, and generated filenames cannot escalate a row to validated or executed.

classification.scope: One pure consumer-neutral classifier uses normalized repository-relative paths plus exact internal document and record types.
priority: trusted generated lineage when a future accepted lineage contract supplies it
classification.historyRule: Historical paths and authority_level=history retain their carrier kind and express history through status and authority_level.
classification.generatedRule: No current producer infers generated-artifact from a path. The value remains reserved until explicit trusted lineage exists.
classification.testRule: Exact test directory segments and conventional test filename forms select test-source; source-observed still means static extraction only.

generatedStores.producerRule: Every producer assigns both fields before rows enter the aggregate generated model. The final generation pass validates but never repairs missing provenance.
generatedStores.decoderRule: Generated row decoders reject missing, non-string, or unknown values as index-corrupt.
generatedStores.generatorRule: Every retrieval session rejects an index whose generator_version differs from the binary even when exact source freshness was not requested.
generatedStores.doctorRule: Doctor uses the same fail-closed generated row decoder as retrieval; missing, non-string, or unknown provenance stops inspection with index-corrupt before an invalid row can enter DoctorResult.

retrieval.fullAndCompact: Full and compact projections preserve both fields on transported evidence. Search also exposes status, authority_level, and record_type so its compact hit is not an ungraded snippet.
retrieval.ranking: The fields are not sparse terms, scoring inputs, boosts, or penalties in v1.17. Existing status and authority ranking remains unchanged.
retrieval.deduplication: Pack shares only exact canonical stable records. Similar text, overlapping ranges or equivalent grading do not merge different record fields or their match edges. Federation also retains distinct provenance grading.
retrieval.diagnose: The best path-local matching row exposes its evidence kind and verification level alongside record type and score.

conflictBoundary.current: Shin can return differently graded evidence together and show exact source paths, ranges, authority, and lifecycle state.
conflictBoundary.notClaimed: Free-form prose and implementation rows do not yet share a universal subject-predicate-value claim model, so Core does not label textual differences as semantic contradictions.
conflictBoundary.futureGate: A deterministic conflict report requires an accepted explicit claim or validation-receipt schema with stable subject identity, predicate, normalized value, source range, snapshot binding, and outcome semantics.

verification: implementation and test source classification without execution claims
machine contract, decision, architecture, operations, structured, and reference classification
history remains an authority and status property
all generated stores contain closed values
generated search, source-scan search, full and compact brief, Pack, diagnose, and federation preserve grading
Pack canonical dedup and federation retain differently graded records; Pack never transports support from a discarded origin
missing, wrong-type, and unknown enum values fail closed
generator mismatch rejects retrieval without requiring --require-current
serial and parallel deterministic identities remain equal
nonGoals: no claim that source is deployed in production
no claim that test-source executed or passed
no trust escalation from consumer-controlled fields
no grading-based scoring change in v1.17
